_comment: Ayala Land retail properties that are NOT exposed by ayalamalls.com's explore-v2 API (verified 2026-07-26: the API returns exactly 32 properties, 31 with directories; mall-id gaps 2/21/22/24/27/33/39/40 were probed and are empty, so no hidden entries exist). Recorded here so the dataset is explicit about coverage limits instead of silently omitting these. `directory_source: null` means no official structured tenant list is published anywhere we could find. Cross-checked against Wikipedia's Ayala Malls property table and Ayala Land press releases.

not_in_api.name: Ayala Malls Arca South
not_in_api.note: Major new mall, ~350 stores. Opened after the app's roster was last updated; expect it to appear in the API - discovery flags it once it does.

not_in_api.name: Ayala Malls Evo City
not_in_api.note: Opened Sept 2025, still absent from the app API.

not_in_api.name: Seagrove
not_in_api.note: Seaside retail strip in the Mactan Newtown estate.

not_in_api.name: The District North Point
not_in_api.note: Listed on the legacy myayalamalls.com site but not the current API.

not_in_api.name: The Walk at Cebu IT Park
not_in_api.note: Adjacent to Ayala Malls Central Bloc, which IS in the API.

not_in_api.name: Garden Bloc at Cebu IT Park
The Link Car Park
not_in_api.note: Car park with ground-floor retail; not a mall by any reasonable definition.

not_in_api.name: Ayala Malls Parklinks
not_in_api.note: Status unclear - announced, opening date not confirmed. Verify before counting.

not_in_api.name: Ayala Malls Gatewalk
not_in_api.note: Not yet open as of this run - excluded from operating counts.

divested_or_transferred.name: Alabang Town Center
divested_or_transferred.note: Ayala Land sold its 50% stake to the Madrigal family in 2025. Correctly absent from the API; stale search-engine results still point at an ayalamalls.com URL that now redirects to /explore.

divested_or_transferred.name: South Park Center
divested_or_transferred.note: Managed by Ayala Land Logistics rather than Ayala Malls; no consumer directory.

api_only_no_directory.name: Ayala Malls Vermosa
api_only_no_directory.note: Present in the API with explore=false and an empty store list - genuine upstream gap, not a scrape failure.
